prompts.instructions: Use source_placement_intake to prepare reusable refactoring knowledge from the functional map and its implementation. Follow its Axiom procedure to record the inference in the source_placement layer. Read an element's prepared knowledge with map_where address=<address>@source_placement.
prompts.jev:
Optional bulk category selection: Jev Match confidence threshold (percent):
During Analyze, use source_placement_associate to classify implementation code by provider category. Build named evidence items keyed by stable IDs containing only the function name and its source code. Keep exact file and symbol identities, source revision and graph coverage limitations locally for verification. Omit candidates to use every eligible provider in the current base. Exclude the literal code root and namespaces rooted at upstream or downstream: these are the organizing root and external elements, not the project implementation being placed. Keep every other provider unless explicitly excluded. When supplying candidates explicitly, include that complete eligible provider list, keyed by named IDs, with provider namespace and verbatim ef. There is no none category. For a provider appearing more than once, retain its distinct EF descriptions under one category.
The tool defines shared criteria once and reuses them for one Choice question per code item: "Which category does the code in `items.<item_id>` belong to?" Every option is presented as Category: followed by the reversed namespace, with code rendered as Program Code, then the verbatim EF text on the next line. For example: Category: Session Controller Program Code Supplies offered agent options, session status, start/stop operations and intake-specific conversation routing. The complete category list is available in every question. Batching splits code items, never category alternatives. No receiving-purpose interpretation is requested in this selection.
source_placement_associate sends the supplied evidence and categories to Jev through OpenRouter. Use it for private evidence only when that disclosure is authorized. Reading this procedure sends nothing. Pass the threshold above as confidence. Oversized items with the full category list require smaller relevant evidence, never silent truncation or an omitted category. Use named records, not array positions.
Attach implementation code directly to the selected provider ELEMENT acting as RE, never to a purpose or join record. Record matched associations through the existing code-link operations with that element as node and an evidence-based why. Retain the model, confidence, probabilities, category identity and source freshness in that element's source_placement knowledge. Spot-check accepted matches against source. Investigate review outcomes through source reads and retain unresolved items. Jev selects the category; the intake agent writes the reasoning and plan. Record returned usage and timing. Existing proposals retain their lifecycle.
prompts.remainder:
Place the remaining implementation code in the provider categories of the existing intake. Project: Run: Intake base:
Read the queue with source_placement_pending run= base=. Use the complete eligible provider categories and their descriptions held by this run. Never select the literal code root or a namespace rooted at upstream or downstream. Every other provider remains eligible unless explicitly excluded from the run. Attach each implementation directly to the selected provider ELEMENT acting as RE, never to a purpose or join record. Read the actual source and relevant callers, surrounding code, state and callback context to decide where each remaining item belongs. A low-confidence Jev choice is a suggestion for investigation. Record your supported placement with source_placement_resolve run= base= item=<item id> provider=<provider address> why=<evidence-based reason>. Include the run and intake base on every pending and resolve call. If the recorded base cannot be accessed or the call reports a base mismatch, leave the work pending and report that condition. Do not substitute the currently active base or activate another base to bypass it. If the source changed or the evidence still cannot support placement, retain that item in the queue and report the missing evidence.
This task records code associations. Do not edit source files or redefine the intake's categories. Continue through the remaining items and re-read source_placement_pending run= base= before marking this work ticket done. Complete the ticket only when that run's remaining queue is empty.
